alert.title: FIELDWATCH OUTBREAK ALERT
alert.body: ALERT: Confirmed {{pest_type}} outbreak detected across {{distinct_fields}} fields in your region. Inspect crops immediately and follow protective advisory.

rejection.non_plant: Image rejected: The submitted photo does not appear to contain a recognized crop or leaf. Please upload a clear photo of the affected plant.
rejection.corrupted: Image rejected: Corrupted or unsupported file format. Please submit JPEG, PNG, or WebP images.

ivr.welcome: Welcome to FieldWatch Toll-Free Pest Advisory.
ivr.select_language: For English press 1. Hindi press 2. Marathi press 3.
ivr.select_symptom: Select symptom: Press 1 for leaf spots, 2 for wilting, 3 for insect damage, 4 for yellowing.
ivr.thank_you: Thank you. Your pest report has been ingested and queued for cluster validation.
